biography:
Business leader with 16 years global leadership experience in digital infrastructure, high-tech, nuclear, oil gas energy resource, mining and critical infrastructure in USA, Canada, APAC 

I have managed large-scale greenfield development, design construction projects and portfolios for Equinix, Apple, Google and Salesforce, led global team, and consistently exceeded customer and business expectations.

I am very honored to be elected on PTC Board of Advisory Council 2025 and have received IM100 award. I am DEI advocate, sustainability and education ambassador and speaker at various industry global conferences and events. I am super passionate about ESG, innovation, technology, serving and making positive impacts in our industry.
